summary: Marriott International filed an 8-K on September 24, 2026, reporting entry into a Seventh Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated September 23, 2026, with Bank of America as administrative agent. The revolver commitments rise from $4.50 billion to $5.00 billion, with a commitment-increase option up to $5.50 billion, and maturity extends from December 14, 2027 to September 23, 2031. Borrowings price at SOFR plus a ratings-based spread with quarterly fees. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; no equity or deal terms arise.
